steps.name: Make the build script run on macOS's bash
steps.comment: macOS ships bash 3.2, which under the script's 'set -u' calls an empty array unbound (bash 4.4 does not), and the array is empty because this recipe does not pass --python: the run stopped at line 243 with 'PYTHON_ARGS[*]: unbound variable'. The guarded spelling is the one the script itself uses everywhere else, gives the same answer on every bash, and needs nothing installed. It is the only expansion on this recipe's path that bash 3.2 refuses.

steps.comment: sed exits 0 when its pattern matches nothing, so the edit is checked rather than trusted
